lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Large, high-luminance circular spots arranged in a semi-regular grid consisting of approximately four horizontal rows and six vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal ridges to form a rectangular framework, with high-intensity spots located at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature on the upper flank showing a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with light reflecting on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct, parallel, high-luminance linear markings are visible on the dorsal surface, anterior to the mid-flank spot grid.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense concentration of smaller, irregularly sized high-luminance spots, providing a distinct texture compared to the larger lateral flank spots.
